decision: Scan set = Drive 'S5 FC3S Scan' folder: S5 Full Car (11a6Ja1z..., 19.96M tris) + Front Face, Hood Down Bumper Off, Hood Off Bumper Off, Hood Up, Rear Bumper Removed; 'FC3S Full Car' (2025) not used
why: Brief suggested the S5 full car because it shares the S5 sessions' Artec frame; regcheck shows all 5 state scans sit on it at identity (median 1.1-2.9 mm, ICP correction <=1 mm/0.05 deg except Front Face 5 mm/0.09 deg)

decision: Levelling = huracan-evo level.py (RANSAC ground) + an extra -2.3 deg roll (level.json) applied identically to every scan; front = +Y, car's right = +X
why: RANSAC plane was not the floor (sills/beltline 65-71 mm lower on the car's right); after the roll fix the beltline is 743.7 vs 741.6 mm L/R. Length 4,304 mm, width 1,696 mm at the doors (FC spec 4,295 x 1,690)

decision: Canonical transform = ive prep of car_4mm_clean (car4.json); every part/state/composite prepped with --like car4.json
why: Lesson: never re-normalise a part separately

decision: Exploded parts: front bumper = 'Front Face' part scan as captured; hood = full car minus 'Hood Up' state (tools/diffpart.py) trimmed to the skin (tools/hoodtrim.py: y 620-2000 mm, <=45 mm under the median hood height); rear bumper = full car minus 'Rear Bumper Removed' in y<-1580 mm
why: No separate hood/rear-bumper part scans exist; the state scans differ from the car exactly by those panels. Hood minus 'Hood Off' leaked fender tops (Hood Off doesn't cover them), so Hood Up was used. Red-over-silver renders (chk/hood2, fb, rb) sit exactly on the car

decision: Explode base comp_explode = car (4 mm) minus hood/front face/rear bumper (9 mm) + Hood Off Bumper Off and Rear Bumper Removed geometry >7 mm from the car inside the removed zones (ferrari-296 composite.py)
why: Lesson: state scans as captured over the trimmed full car; render shows radiator support, crash bars and engine bay from real scan data

decision: Hood opens 44.4 deg about a hinge at y=0.635 m z=0.975 m (prepped frame) - tools/hinge.py fit of the closed hood onto the open hood in 'Hood Up' (median 2.6 mm)
why: Fitted to the real propped hood so the opening lands exactly on the captured state; red-over-silver check shows the two hoods z-fighting

decision: Shot plan: s1 front 3/4 turntable (low, 18->40 deg) -> s2 rear-left 3/4 orbit -> s3 front-right wheel/arch close-up -> s4 nose (pop-up lid, indicator, bumper) -> s5 right mirror/A-pillar glide -> s6 hood opens to the 'Hood Up' angle -> s7 high rear 3/4 to top-down -> s8 exploded view -> logo
why: Brief's Temerario order (turntables, extreme close-ups, hood open, top-down, exploded, logo); shots rendered slightly long so project.yaml can trim them to the music's accents once the track arrives

decision: No tail-lamp close-up; mirror glide instead
why: Tail-lamp lenses and the rear hatch glass are scan holes (dark blotches with speckle) in the full car; never feature hero areas with holes

decision: Wheel close-up framed on the upper half of the front-right wheel + arch (target z 0.64-0.68 m, 48 mm), slide stops at y 1.4 m
why: The hub centre and the lower-right rim have scan holes; the upper tyre sidewall lettering, spokes and arch/suspension are clean

decision: Close-ups (s3-s5) use a 2 mm crop of the front-right quarter (fr_2mm, crop seam at x=-0.39/y=-0.14 m kept out of frame); full-car shots use 4 mm
why: Style guide: <=2 mm for close-ups; a crop keeps Blender memory down

decision: Turntables pulled out to 6.2-6.4 m so the whole car stays inside 9:16 (first test cropped the nose only)
why: A one-sided crop of the nose looked accidental; the car still fills ~85% of the width

decision: Top-down kept despite the rear-glass hole
why: Brief asks for top-down; glass doesn't scan, it reads as a dark window on black. Not inventing glass

decision: Pop-up headlights: all states used (full car, Hood Up, Hood Off Bumper Off) have the lids down - checked in the overlay renders
why: Brief warned the lights may differ between sessions; no close-up relies on them being up

decision: Logo = illumaesthetic.com header logo (IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png, 6135x1059) saved as remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png at 2400 px
why: File is gitignored and was missing in this container; brief says to take it from the website

decision: Music = mazda-rx7-fc_track.mp3 (generated for this reel by the parent session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield); grid = 9.067 s + k*0.5661 s (106.0 BPM), bars from 10.199 s
why: ive beats said 107.7 BPM; the 40-120 Hz band here is an eighth-note bass line (peaks every 0.28 s), so the grid is fitted on the broadband hit/snare flux peaks: 9.636->35.677 s is exactly 23 x 1.1322 s, and the grid also lands on the soft intro hits (0.586, 2.281 s)

decision: Track structure: soft intro 0-9.07 s (no hits), drums enter 9.067 s, kick in 12.463-21.52 s (loudest, -9.5 dB), kickless breakdown 21.52-33 s, soft kick return 33.2 s, last hit 36.10 s, -30 dB by 36.56 s, silent ~37.8 s
why: Per-second RMS and per-beat kick/flux table (tools/music_grid.py, copied from porsche-gt3-992)

decision: Cuts: s1 0 / s2 4.539 / s3 9.067 (drums enter) / s4 11.331 / s6 hood 12.463 (kick drop) / s5 mirror 16.428 / s7 top 18.692 / s8 explode 21.52 (kick drops out) / logo 33.408 / end 37.4 s
why: Slow 8-beat turntables over the soft intro (Temerario opens slowly; hook = the car is already turning on frame 1); 2-7 beat holds in the drum section on the strongest snares (10.768-20.956 s peaks 0.94-1.0); explode fills the breakdown

decision: Explode: panels lift on the 22.088 s snare (shot +0.566), fully out on 24.352 s (strong hit), drift while orbiting, start home 30.012 s, lock 32.276 s (0.90 hit), hold assembled to the logo at 33.408 s
why: Weightless kickless breakdown suits floating panels; locking on a strong hit, then 2 beats of assembled car before the logo

decision: Hood opens from shot +1 beat (13.032 s snare) to +5 beats (14.728 s downbeat)
why: Motion lands on the music instead of an arbitrary 0.8-3.4 s

decision: s8 explode camera: 11 keys sampled along a 30->64 deg arc, r 7.6->7.9, orbit centre (0.15,0.5->0.4), target z 1.05; bumper offsets lifted to y+-0.55 z+0.75
why: 2-key 42->112 deg move interpolated loc on the chord and cropped the car mid-shot; past ~70 deg the bumpers' fore-aft spread is wider than the 9:16 frame; centre moved forward so the front bumper clears the right edge

decision: s8 final: frames 102-178 came out unlit (dark silhouette, mean luma 3.9 vs 19.8) and rendered 2x fast; re-rendered that range alone via spec frames list
why: lighting dropped mid-render in the long animated job (no error in log); the same frames were lit in preview, so it was a render fault not a shot fault. Found only by the frame-diff scan of the assembled reel

decision: v2: beat grid measured against broadband kick onset (1 ms RMS, 4 ms peak-hold, half-rise) on all 22 drum-section beats of the v1 file: grid is 23 ms early (MAD 2 ms); fix with music.start 0.023 then re-check each cut
why: relayed user rule (all V1 reels): verify cut timing against the decoded audio; the v1 spectral-flux check (+-14 ms) locked to the leading edge of each hit, while the 1 ms half-rise shows v1 cuts 4-41 ms early

decision: v2: Cycles persistent data off in tools/shot.py; per-frame luma scan of all 8 render folders before assembly (no dropouts; max step 1.5 in s7 camera move, 0.4 at the s8 re-render join)
why: relayed user rule (all V1 reels): persistent data dropped the studio lights mid-animation in s8 v1, WRX VA, Cappuccino and Civic 11
